summary.name: Trancy
summary.one_liner: Trancy is a language-learning browser tool that adds AI bilingual subtitles to video sites like YouTube and Netflix and offers AI word, sentence, and full-page translation for web articles.
use_cases: Learning a language by watching YouTube or Netflix with two subtitle languages
Looking up unfamiliar words and sentences while reading foreign-language web pages
Building personal vocabulary lists and example sentences for review
Practicing listening and speaking with video content
Translating full articles side by side with the original text
summary.what_it_does: Trancy shows bilingual subtitles on platforms such as YouTube, Netflix, HBO Max, TED, edX, Coursera, Udemy and Disney+, with theater and reading viewing modes. Clicking words gives definitions, and the tool can break down sentence structure and tag parts of speech. On regular web pages, it translates selected words or whole sentences, supports full-text translation via right-click or shortcut keys, and can show original and translated text side by side. Users can save words and example sentences to a word list and create learning decks. The page also lists playback speed control, subtitle styling, text-to-speech, keyboard shortcuts and speech recognition. It says it supports up to 10 languages.
notable: Bilingual subtitles on YouTube, Netflix, Coursera, TED and other video sites with reading mode
Webpage selection and full-text immersive translation with a choice of engines such as Google, DeepL and OpenAI
Word and sentence analysis using OpenAI and NLP, with saved word lists and learning decks
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing marks it as free, but the page itself does not confirm this
Support for specific sites and features is described on the page, but the page does not list browsers or required accounts
